<?php
// CF problem: compute product_{y=1..n} f(x,y) mod 1e9+7
// Implementation in PHP

const MOD = 1000000007;

// fast modular exponentiation
function mod_pow($base, $exp, $mod) {
    $base %= $mod;
    $res = 1;
    while ($exp > 0) {
        if ($exp & 1) {
            $res = ($res * $base) % $mod;
        }
        $base = ($base * $base) % $mod;
        $exp >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

// factorize x into distinct primes
function factorize($x) {
    $primes = [];
    $d = 2;
    while ((int)$d * $d <= $x) {
        if ($x % $d == 0) {
            $primes[] = $d;
            while ($x % $d == 0) $x /= $d;
        }
        $d += ($d == 2) ? 1 : 2; // check 2, then odd numbers
    }
    if ($x > 1) $primes[] = $x;
    return $primes;
}

// read input
$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($xStr, $nStr) = array_map('trim', explode(' ', $line));
$x = intval($xStr);
$n = intval($nStr);

$primes = factorize($x);
$ans = 1;

foreach ($primes as $p) {
    // compute exponent of prime p in the final product
    $exp = 0;
    $pp = $p;
    while ($pp <= $n) {
        // floor(n / pp)
        $exp += intdiv($n, $pp);
        if ($pp > intdiv($n, $p)) break; // avoid overflow
        $pp *= $p;
    }
    $ans = ($ans * mod_pow($p, $exp, MOD)) % MOD;
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>

function mod_pow($base, $exp, $mod) {
    $base %= $mod;
    $res = 1;
    while ($exp > 0) {
        if ($exp & 1) {
            $res = ($res * $base) % $mod;
        }
        $base = ($base * $base) % $mod;
        $exp >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

// Factorize x into its distinct prime factors
function factorize($x) {
    $primes = [];
    $d = 2;
    while ((int)$d * $d <= $x) {
        if ($x % $d == 0) {
            $primes[] = $d;
            while ($x % $d == 0) {
                $x /= $d;
            }
        }
        $d += ($d == 2) ? 1 : 2; // check 2, then odd numbers
    }
    if ($x > 1) {
        $primes[] = $x;
    }
    return $primes;
}

// Read input
$line = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($xStr, $nStr) = explode(' ', $line);
$x = intval($xStr);
$n = intval($nStr); // may be large but fits in PHP int (64-bit)

// Factorize x
$primes = factorize($x);

$ans = 1;

foreach ($primes as $p) {
    $pp = $p;
    // For each power p^k <= n, add floor(n / p^k) to exponent
    while ($pp <= $n) {
        $cnt = intdiv($n, $pp);
        if ($cnt == 0) break;
        $ans = ($ans * mod_pow($p, $cnt, MOD)) % MOD;

        if ($pp > intdiv($n, $p)) break;
        $pp *= $p;
    }
}

?>

// CF problem: f(x,1)*...*f(x,n) mod 1e9+7
// Read input
list($xStr, $nStr) = array_map('trim', explode(' ', trim(fgets(STDIN))));
$x = intval($xStr);
$n = intval($nStr); // n can be up to 1e18, but PHP int is 64-bit

$MOD = 1000000007;

// Fast power mod
function modPow($base, $exp, $mod) {
    $base %= $mod;
    $res = 1;
    while ($exp > 0) {
        if ($exp & 1) {
            $res = ($res * $base) % $mod;
        }
        $base = ($base * $base) % $mod;
        $exp >>= 1;
    }
    return $res;
}

// Factorize x to get distinct prime divisors
function primeFactors($x) {
    $res = [];
    $d = 2;
    while ($d * $d <= $x) {
        if ($x % $d == 0) {
            $res[] = $d;
            while ($x % $d == 0) $x /= $d;
        }
        $d += ($d == 2 ? 1 : 2); // 2,3,5,7,... (skip even >2)
    }
    if ($x > 1) $res[] = $x;
    return $res;
}

$primes = primeFactors($x);
$ans = 1;

// For each prime p | x, exponent in result is sum_{k>=1} floor(n / p^k)
foreach ($primes as $p) {
    $power = $p;
    $expSum = 0;
    $nn = $n;
    while ($power <= $nn) {
        $expSum += intdiv($nn, $power);
        if ($power > intdiv(PHP_INT_MAX, $p)) break; // avoid overflow
        $power *= $p;
    }
    $ans = ($ans * modPow($p, $expSum, $MOD)) % $MOD;
}

echo $ans . PHP_EOL;
?>
